[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 1: Behavior Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.1[/color] Don't be a dick, aka, do not intentionally take actions that would negatively impact or disrupt others' enjoyment of the game except when required by your role.
[color=#a4885c]1.2[/color] Avoid controversial topics such as self harm/rape in public.
[color=#a4885c]1.3[/color][color=#00fffb] Don't evade bans in any way, including account sharing or alt accounts. This will be reported to wizden.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.4[/color][color=#00fffb] Taking actions that may harm the server's integrity or stability, such as lag farms, DDoS attacks, or public defamation is forbidden.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.5[/color][color=#00fffb] Impersonation of a position or person is forbidden. Do not pretend to be an admin, do not pretend to be someone you're not out-of-character.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.6[/color][color=#00fffb] If you are frustrated and need a break, you are free to ragequit/disconnect however this will not avoid consequences when you return.[/color]
